events.summary: 巴昆载着塔拉辛与奥里亚尔冲破火山口飞上天空，奥里亚尔开始尖叫。
events.quote: But it wasn’t until Bakun suddenly shot up—through the darkness, out of the abyss, great wings unfolding once they’d slid past the rim of the crater—that Oryal began to scream.

events.summary: 两人穿过一处银丝般的维度裂缝，塔拉辛认出那是联结世界的以太。
events.quote: This was aether. The threads that bound the world. This was a place that was not a place, a crack between dimensions.

events.summary: 巴昆在山脚硬着陆，力竭的塔拉辛只能向前爬行。
events.quote: The landing was rough. Bakun hit the base of the mountain range like an earthquake, sending up veritable blizzards of dust.

events.summary: 一队身着虹彩鳞甲、手持光织长矛的人从丛林中现身。
events.quote: Each one was clad in iridescent armor crafted with the same type of reptile scale, predominantly green but mottled with glints of amber and cerulean.

events.summary: 戴羽饰头冠的老妇用塔拉辛的本名“阿伦西娜”称呼她，并说他们一直在等她。
events.quote: “Alunsina.” Her voice was dry and weathered and familiar. Her eyes were the same eyes that Talasyn had once seen in a dream, and the eyes that she saw whenever she looked into a mirror. “We were waiting for you.”

events.summary: 塔拉辛向姨妈卡希尔和盘托出，包括乌尔杜贾·西利姆杀害哈南一事。
events.quote: “First things first, you have to know—Urduja Silim killed Hanan Ivralis,” she blurted out, and then she was telling her aunt everything.

events.summary: 卡希尔告诉她，只要徒步登上太阳之路最高峰，就可能找回以太术。
events.quote: If you undertake this pilgrimage, I believe that you might be able to find what you seek. There on the spine of the world.

events.summary: 月食之夜塔拉辛痛得无法醒来，在心中呼唤阿拉里克，随后一个声音回应了她。
events.quote: “I see,” said a cold, dry voice, as dear to her as her own heartbeat. “So this is what happens when there’s an eclipse and we’re not with each other. How incredibly irritating.”

relations.relation: 姨甥（Cahyir 是 Hanan 的姐姐，塔拉辛的姨妈兼族人首领）
relations.quote: “You are my sister’s daughter, so you will make it through. I have every faith.

relations.relation: 姐妹（Hanan 是 Cahyir 的妹妹，随多米尼恩王子离去后再未归来）
relations.quote: “My headstrong little sister. When she left with the Dominion prince—as soon as their ship vanished into the sky—I knew that I would never see her again in this life.”

relations.relation: 夫妻（塔拉辛称其为丈夫，二人在月食中相隔两地）
relations.quote: Why do all that for me, she asked her husband, wherever he was, when you were just going to take away my magic and hold me hostage

relations.relation: 俘虏与押送者（奥里亚尔曾绑架王储，如今被塔拉辛带在龙背上）
relations.quote: “Of the two people on this dragon, I’m not the one who abducted the heir to the throne, Daya Ferasai,” Talasyn pointed out.

numbers.context: 太阳之路山脉由七座覆满丛林的山峰组成
numbers.quote: The mountain range was known as the Path of the Sun, comprising seven peaks carpeted in thick jungle.

numbers.context: 塔拉辛形容所骑的巨龙长达千米
numbers.quote: Leave it to a Dominion noble to be a pain in the neck while riding a thousand-meter-long creature straight out of legend.

numbers.context: 卡希尔说几小时后将发生月食，并从药箱取出一瓶止痛药水
numbers.quote: “There’s an eclipse in a few hours,” Cahyir explained. She retrieved a corked vial from the medicine chest at the foot of the bed and thrust it into Talasyn’s hands.

numbers.context: 塔拉辛觉得像在海上漂了数周，而实际只过了几小时
numbers.quote: She felt as though she’d been sailing for sennights, not hours.

numbers.context: 黑暗中同时炸开的银色光丝数量
numbers.quote: It was so sudden, that darkness, blacker than black for a heartbeat before streaks of lightning burst all around, dozens upon dozens, flashing all at once . . .

notes: 标题重复：第 1 行与第 12 行各有一处「Chapter Thirty-Three」；第 3–11 行为连续空行（原文提取残留）。本章正文自第 15 行起。
